title: Oscar and the Witness
author: J. M. Thornbury
blurb: Beatrix Coldharbour, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
